notes.zh-CN: 浏览器画面不再白屏：画面流中断后会自动重连，停靠面板和弹出窗口也不会再互相抢流——同一时间只由一个窗口显示页面，另一个会提示「这个标签正在另一个窗口显示」，点一下就能切回来。标签页按下 × 立即关闭（也可以中键关闭），Chromium 拒绝关闭时会直接说明原因，而不是把标签藏起来当作已关闭。第三方模型（DeepSeek、Kimi 等）的用量不再只是一个「—」：现在显示本次会话的输入、输出、缓存词元和模型调用次数，并说明这类模型没有套餐额度。
notes.en: The browser pane stops going blank: a screencast that drops now reconnects on its own, and the docked pane and the pop-out window no longer pull the stream away from each other — one window shows the page at a time and the other says "This tab is showing in another window" with a button to take it back. Tabs close the moment you press × (middle-click works too), and when Chromium refuses a close it says why instead of hiding the tab as if it had closed. Third-party models (DeepSeek, Kimi and so on) no longer show a bare "—" for usage: the pill reports this session's input, output, cached tokens and model calls, and notes that these models have no plan allowance.
